audio.time_base: seconds from the first sample of "inputs/Merge (keychange down).wav" (48 kHz; analysed as the identical copy work_v3/song.wav). NOT interchangeable with analysis_v2/ (inputs/Merge.wav): use analysis_v3/warp_v2_to_v3.json for the old->new time map (see analysis_v3/NOTES.md).

also: analysis_v3/stems/vocals_roformer.wav (BS-RoFormer, cleaner, used for alignment checks)

drift.note: NOT CONSTANT (unlike v2, which is 138.00 throughout): smooth accelerando ~137.8 BPM (intro) -> 138.2 (verse 1) -> 138.5-138.8 (bars 33-80) -> 139.0 (build) -> 139.5 (drop) -> 140.6-141.0 (verse 2 to outro), ~140.3-140.7 in the drumless tail. Fitted to kick onsets (2.8 ms rms) and the drumless arp comb with a smoothing spline; cross-checked against the v2 grid carried through an onset-envelope alignment (agreement 1-15 ms in drum sections).
drift.warning: A constant-BPM grid is useless here: the best constant line is off by up to 633 ms. Cut on beats[] / bars[] only.

tempo.meter: 4/4, four-on-the-floor where drums play; bar 1 beat 1 = 0.219 s; 8-bar phrases throughout (every section starts on bar 8n+1); the final hit falls on bar 161 beat 3 (see NOTES)

key.suno_claim: B minor (claim for the original render; this version is transposed down 2 semitones)
key.estimate: A minor (relative C major very prominent)
key.evidence: v2 harmony transposed down a whole tone throughout, no key change inside the song. Harmonic-stem (other+bass) chroma: C major r=0.777 / A minor r=0.765 (no sharps/flats; v2 gave D major / B minor with the same r pattern); verse blocks best-fit A minor / C major, chorus blocks C major colour; every block's best key is the v2 block key minus 2 semitones or its relative.

beat_grid.convention: beats[i]: i from 0, bar = i//4+1, beat = i%4+1. zone: anchored = fitted to drum-stem kick onsets (drum sections) or to the plucked-arp onset comb (drumless sections); interpolated = no rhythmic anchor within +-2 beats (15.9-20.3, 56.7-61.9, 71.5-75.8, 91.4-96.6, 103.1-103.5, 202.3-202.7, 204.8-207.0, 209.1-220.6 = Chorus 2 first half, 222.7-235.0 = Chorus 2 second half, 263.6-276.0 = pads after the bar-153 hit; the tempo drifts, so interpolated stretches are less certain than in v2: see NOTES); extrapolated = after 277.25 s (after the final hit).
beat_grid.verification: kick onsets vs grid residual rms 2.8 ms (p95 5.1 ms); arp-comb anchors rms 2.5 ms; downbeat phase = beat_this downbeat vote (222 of 261 on phase 0, 29 on phase 2); every section hit lands on a downbeat within 13 ms (bars 9, 17, 37, 41, 57, 65, 69, 73, 86, 89, 105, 117, 121, 129, 137, 149, 153); independent estimate (v2 grid through an onset alignment) agrees within 7.4 ms mean |diff| (per section in NOTES).

sections.name: Intro
sections.description: Pads + plucked arp fading in (mix > -40 dBFS from 0.65 s). Low synth bass audible in bars 1-4 (~1.2-6.9 s; only faint in v2) and again from bar 7 beat 3 (~11.3). NO soft hat/snare pattern in bars 5-7 (v2 had one from bar 5). Drum pickup in bar 8, then bar 9 (14.18): kick hit + rolling bass. Bars 13-16: bass out by ~24.5, pads; a sustained low tone in both vocal stems 25.8 -> 28.6 (starts ~2.5 s later than in v2, see adlibs). No lyric.

parts.name: Intro A - pads/arp fade-in, low bass bars 1-4
Intro B - kick hit + rolling bass (bar 9), pads from bar 13

sections.name: Verse 1
sections.description: Kick/bass hit on bar 17 (28.10); soft low vocal starts 28.68. No steady drums. Bass under the verse (louder than in v2).

sections.name: Pre-Chorus
sections.description: Vocal pickup "And every" starts 54.77 - before the bar line. Bass fades out during bar 33 (v2: out from bar 34 beat 4). Kick hit on bar 37 (62.77) under the held "from"; filter riser 64.9 -> 69.72 (bars 38-40).

sections.name: Chorus 1
sections.description: Hit on bar 41 (69.720); "Merge" scoops in at 69.45, before the bar. Stripped chorus: no steady kick and, unlike v2, NO second kick hit at bar 52. Bass bars 41-54, out from ~94.0 (bar 54 beat 3). Last line "Nothing that I lived can come undone" ("undone" held to ~99.0).

sections.name: Breakdown
sections.description: Hit/crash on bar 57 (97.445). Strings/pads; "Branch... and wander..." 102.52, "Merge... and return..." 109.31; wordless "Ahh... ahh..." 111.74-125.6. Second half (bars 65-72) is a BUILD: kick hit + 16th hats from bar 65 (111.30), snare crescendo from 116.48, 32nd-note snare roll bar 72 (123.29-124.71). Same arrangement as v2 (kick pulse in bars 70-72 louder).

parts.name: Breakdown B - first build: hats + snare crescendo under "Ahh"

sections.name: Build Up
sections.description: Full kick + bass slam on bar 73 (125.13, strongest bar-line onset of the song). Four-on-the-floor groove bars 73-85, NO VOCAL (RoFormer vocal stem < -60 dB 126-171 s; whisper hallucinated "Bye"/"Oh my God" here). Bar 86 (147.60): bass out, kick continues to ~150.5 then fades while snare/hats continue; snare build 150.85 -> drop; mix brightens into the drop. Same as v2.

parts.name: Build Up A - full-drum groove (impact 125.13), no vocal
Build Up B - bass out, kick fading, snare build + riser

sections.name: Instrumental Drop
sections.description: DROP IMPACT 152.79 (bar 89 downbeat). Full kick/bass + lead + strings. Sustained wordless "ooh" layer in the vocal stems 172.54-180.3 (bars 100-104, as in v2; adlib, not a lyric). Bass thins out in bar 104; 16th snare fill 179.09-180.38 into Verse 2.

sections.name: Verse 2
sections.description: Impact on bar 105 (180.38), vocal 181.40. Improvised high melody (high notes on THE 184.66, I 189.81, THAT 196.46 held to 197.27, BE 203.52). Sung OVER full drums bars 105-116; bar 117 (200.99): one more kick HIT on the downbeat (v2: no hit), then drums + bass out (by ~201.3) for the last line.

parts.name: Verse 2 B - hit on bar 117, then drums out

sections.name: Chorus 2
sections.description: HIT on bar 121 (207.82): kick + bass return (v2 had NO hit here: pads only until bar 129). "Merge" scoops in at 207.58, 0.24 s before the bar; "ME" 209.88. No steady kick bars 122-128; bass under bars 121-133, out from ~229.5 (v2: bass bars 129-136). No kick/snare pickup before bar 129 (v2 had one). Hit on bar 129 (221.44). Filter riser bars 135-136 (231.6-235.04), snare pickup 234.58. Last line "Every life I've lived, I have become".

sections.name: Outro
sections.description: "Back to main" #1 is a pickup at 234.16 (end of Chorus 2). Bar 137 (235.04) full-drum outro drop; "main" held to ~238.0 and then NO wordless vocalise (v2 had one 238.66-248.97: the v3 vocal stems are silent ~238.5-247.7). "Back to main" #2 at 247.76, "main" held to ~251.2 (v2 ~4 s longer). Bar 149 (255.49): last kick, drums + bass out: arp alone. NEW: faint high sustained tone (~C5) in the vocal stems 260.85-264.3. Riser into bar 153: kick + bass hit 262.300, arp stops, then pads + bass sustain with chord changes on bars 155/157/159. NEW: FINAL HIT 276.82 (kick + last chord change) on bar 161 BEAT 3 - 2 beats later than the 2-bar chord rhythm predicts (v2: chord change on the bar-161 downbeat, no hit). Fade to < -40 dBFS at 282.23; file ends 282.800.

parts.name: Outro A - final drop with held vocal
Outro B - drums out, arp alone
Outro C - last section hit, pads + bass, final hit bar 161 beat 3, fade

lyrics.method: Known lyric text force-aligned per line on the vocal stems with 4 CTC runs (torchaudio MMS_FA + wav2vec2-large-960h, each on demucs htdemucs_ft and BS-RoFormer vocals; median start) cross-checked with stable-ts/whisper-large-v3 alignment; starts snapped to syllable onsets (energy/pitch) within -90/+50 ms; sibilant onsets backtracked to the start of frication; line starts and ambiguous words corrected by visual inspection of spectrogram + pitch panels (work_v3/overrides.json; every v2 override re-checked on the v3 audio, values measured in v3). Search windows = v2 windows mapped by musical position, +-0.2 s. Word ends = next word start, or the end of the sustained note (RoFormer RMS > max(peak-20, -40) dB).

vs_lyric_sheet: Same words, same line order and the same 22 sung lines as v2 (faster-whisper on the v3 vocal stem, with and without prompt, plus windowed re-transcription). ASR mishearings such as "Back to Maine/me", "Branch and wonder", "This French", "something that I love", "Nothing that I left" are breathy-vowel artefacts as in v2; windowed ASR gives "Nothing that I lived can come undone".
"Back to main..." is sung TWICE (234.16, 247.76), as in v2.
NO wordless vocalise after the first held "main" (v2 had one, 238.66-248.97): the held "main" ends ~238.0 and the vocal stems are silent until "Back to main" #2.
"Ahh... ahh..." = two long wordless notes 111.74-118.17 and 118.20-125.6 (leap up on bar 69); no consonants, boundary to "return" is musical.
No vocal in the Build Up (RoFormer stem < -60 dB 126-171 s); the ASR outputs "Bye" / "Oh my God" there are hallucinations.

Unlisted: low sustained tone in the vocal stems 25.8-28.6 before the first line, a wordless "ooh" layer 172.54-180.28 in the drop, and (new) a faint high tone 260.85-264.3 before the last section hit (adlibs, lip_sync false).
Verse 2 improvisation as in v2: high notes on THE (184.66), I (189.81), THAT (196.46-197.27, held), BE (203.52). Chorus 2 "ME" emphasised (209.88).
No extra chorus repeats; choruses are not doubled.

spot_check.method: independent onset on the demucs vocal stem (steepest 2-8 kHz or broadband rise, backtracked) vs predicted start; |err|>90 ms cases are b/p words where the prediction marks lip closure and the measure marks the burst/vowel
